artifact.witchking-artifacts.amuletOfDra: Worn about the neck, this item increases your Sorcery skill by 5%

Deep within the Dragon Peaks, you discover a hidden cavern where an ancient artifact rested on a pedestal made of dragon bone. The Amulet of Dragon Eye, glowing with an otherworldly light, calls to you. As you grasp the amulet, a surge of draconic power fills your mind, revealing the secrets of ancient dragon sorcery.
Allows hero to cast Death Ripple and Animate Dead at expert level.

In the shadowy depths of a forgotten tomb, you uncover the Book of the Dead with cover etched with cryptic runes and bound in ancient, decayed leather. As you open the book, a chill sweeps through the air, and ghostly whispers fill your ears, revealing forbidden necromantic knowledge.
artifact.witchking-artifacts.crownOfSkie: Allows hero to cast expert Chain Lightning and improves its damage by 50%

Amidst a fierce storm atop a mountain peak, you find the Crown of the Skies resting on a stone altar, with lightning crackling around it. As you don the crown, the storm's fury seems to calm, and a surge of power courses through you.
artifact.witchking-artifacts.dwarvenHelm: Increases hero defense skill by 2 and renders units immune to defence-reducing spells

In a hidden chamber beneath the mountains, you discover the Dwarven Helmet, a masterwork of ancient craftsmanship. As you place it on your head, a solid, unwavering sense of protection settles over you.
artifact.witchking-artifacts.dwarvenMine: At the beginning of battle casts expert Landmine with spell power of 10
In a secluded, rocky valley, you stumble upon the Dwarven Mine, an ancient relic buried beneath layers of stone. Upon claiming it, you feel the earth itself become an ally.
artifact.witchking-artifacts.healersRing: Doubles effectiveness of First Aid skill. First Aid Tent will always heal at least 50 points of damage
Within a serene glade, you discover the Healer's Ring, a simple band glowing with a soft, comforting light. As you slipped it on, a warm energy enveloped you, enhancing your healing abilities.
artifact.witchking-artifacts.philosphers: Grants wielder 10% bonus to Intelligence skill.
In an old library, you discover the Philosopher's Stone. Its surface is shimmering with an otherworldly glow. As you pick it up, new knowledge and insight flow into your mind.
artifact.witchking-artifacts.ritualDagge: Allows to upgrade all Mages, Archmages, Monks and Zealots in your army to Liches
In a dark, mist-shrouded grove, you unearth the Ritual Dagger. Its blade is etched with eerie symbols of necromancy. As you take hold of it, a sinister power begin to resonate within your army.
artifact.witchking-artifacts.sacredWarHa: Casts expert Bless at the beginning of battle. All allied units do 50% more damage to Skeletons.
In a revered shrine, your discover the Sacred War Hammer, its surface gleaming with divine energy. The moment you grasp it, a powerful blessing spread through your ranks.
artifact.witchking-artifacts.shieldOfArr: ncreases hero defense skill by 2 and reduces effectiveness of enemy Archery skill by half
In a remote armory, you find the Shield of Arrow Turning, its metal polished to a mirror-like shine. As you raise it, the air around you seemed to bend, deflecting incoming threats.
Creatures in your army get ability to drain enemy mana each turn.
Within a tower's depths, you discover the Soul Prison, a relic resting atop a bag of bones. Upon claiming it, the artifact's power spread through your troops.
Decreases speed of all flying untis on the battlefield by 2.
On a windswept cliff, you uncover the Storm Stone, crackling with static power. As you claime it, the skies darkened, and the winds grew heavy.
artifact.witchking-artifacts.wizardsWand: Reduces cost of all spells by 2.
In a forgotten chamber, you encounter the Wizard's Wand, its surface glowing with arcane symbols. As you grasp it, a wave of magical efficiency courses through your being.
